# Original university deliverable

`Tablut.jar` is the original archive from the university submission, preserved byte-for-byte. Its classes use Java 25 bytecode (major version 69).

It is a historical artifact and does not include the current refactoring or corrections. Build the maintained Java 21 application using `bash scripts/build.sh` from the repository root; run `build/Tablut.jar`.
